title: Patient Payment Plan Returned-Payment Fee Rates by Prior Returns
content:
**Fee schedule — returned-payment fee rate on a Patient Payment Plan**

The returned-fee rate follows the returned-payment fees already booked on the plan: with none counted it is 15.00, with exactly one counted it is 20.00, and with two or more it is the tier's returned-payment fee.

| Tier | Tier's returned-payment fee (USD) | Rate with none counted | Rate with exactly one counted | Rate with two or more counted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Short-Term 3-Month Payment Plan | 25.00 | 15.00 | 20.00 | 25.00 |
| Standard 6-Month Payment Plan | 25.00 | 15.00 | 20.00 | 25.00 |
| Extended 10-Month Payment Plan | 25.00 | 15.00 | 20.00 | 25.00 |
| Long-Term 12-Month Payment Plan | 25.00 | 15.00 | 20.00 | 25.00 |
| Large-Balance 18-Month Payment Plan | 25.00 | 15.00 | 20.00 | 25.00 |
| Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan | 0.00 | 15.00 | 20.00 | 0.00 |

Notes to the schedule:

1. The rate depends only on the count: 0 gives 15.00 and 1 gives 20.00 on every tier.
2. From the second counted fee onward, the rate is the tier's own returned-payment fee: 25.00 on five tiers and 0.00 on the Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan.
